name: Jing-jin Electric Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Established in 2008 and headquartered in Beijing, China, Jing-Jin Electric Technologies (Beijing) Co., Ltd. is a global provider of advanced solutions for passenger and commercial vehicles. The company's diverse product portfolio encompasses key components for electric propulsion systems, including electric motors, e-motor controllers, electric drive modules, and electric machines. It also supplies hybrid powertrain elements such as hybrid transmissions and range extenders. Furthermore, Jing-Jin Electric offers comprehensive power battery products, specifically Battery Management Systems (BMS) and complete powerpacks.
